questions.question_text: A sum doubles in 4 years under annual compounding. What is the ratio of the compound interest earned in year 4 to that earned in year 1?
questions.explanation: The annual growth factor x satisfies x^4=2. The ratio of year-4 to year-1 interest is x^3=2^(3/4).
questions.source: Original SSC-style practice; independently calculated; concepts checked against NCERT Class VIII Mathematics, Chapter 8: Comparing Quantities (ncert.nic.in/textbook.php?hemh1=8-14)
